messages:
Ava: Quick copy sprint today  focus: tighten hero lines + CTAs for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. Aim: clearer buyer signals, simpler language, and explicit inbound routing.

Diego: Kicked off some Hosted hero options:
- hosted option A: Ship LLM features in minutes, pay-as-you-go
- hosted option B: Low-latency text + embeddings, no infra to maintain
- hosted option C: Start free, production-ready inference for engineers

Sarah: I like option B (concise, benefit-driven). Suggest tiny KPI chips under hero: 50200ms median latency | Curated open models. Keep hero vertical space small.

Mike: Add a tiny benchmark callout beside CTA: Benchmarks: ~720 tokens/sec per GPU in our harness. Also note model families supported (transformers, Llama variants).

Diego: Dedicated hero ideas:
- Predictable throughput with reserved GPU pools
- Committed capacity for production SLAs and isolation
- Reserved pools  predictable cost + latency

Diego: Private page options:
- Private inference: run models inside your network
- VPC & on-prem with KMS/HSM integrations
- Air-gapped deployment for regulated data

Julia: Routing rules (important):
- Hosted CTA -> self-serve signup flow (free trial).
- Dedicated / Private CTAs -> lead-capture form routed to Sales/SE. Capture company size, cloud preference, estimated monthly tokens.
- Quick rule: if company ARR > $1M, route to AE.

Lily: For Dedicated/Private, add a clear "Request quote" button (not just generic contact). Form fields: ARR bracket, target QPS, compliance needs checkbox (SOC2 / ISO / HIPAA). Checkboxes trigger compliance SE routing.

Diego: CTA microcopy suggestions:
- Hosted: Start free  no credit card
- Dedicated: Request dedicated capacity
- Private: Talk to sales about Private

Ava: Let's A/B test Hosted hero: benefit-led vs feature-led. Diego, can you paste a tiny AB config snippet for experiments?

Diego: Sure, quick snippet (for devs):
```
{'experiment': 'hosted_hero_ab', 'variants': [{'id': 'benefit', 'headline': 'Ship LLM features in minutes, pay-as-you-go'}, {'id': 'feature', 'headline': 'Low-latency text & embeddings, production-ready'}], 'metric': 'signup_rate'}
```

Sarah: Page layout recommendation: three stacked product rails (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) each with short bullets + CTA. Lower on page: compact comparison table (columns: deployment time, SLA, typical cost profile).

Mike: Add a collapsible section for model compatibility and quantization notes (int8, fallback to smaller models to keep SLOs). Two-line benchmark snippet near the bottom for readers who want details.

Julia: Webinar tie-in: host a short session  "Selecting an inference mode: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private"  target week of Apr 12. Use as gated asset for mid-funnel leads; tag attendees as webinar-attended to bump lead score.

ops-bot: Reminder  all lead forms must append UTM params and channel tag (paid/search/email) and include a hidden first_touch field for routing.

Lily: Also request a one-line customer testimonial on the Dedicated page about predictable latency and fewer production incidents. Short quote is fine.

Ava: Action items: Diego finalize headlines + AB snippet by EOD, Sarah build mockups tomorrow, Julia create webinar landing + gating, Lily draft Dedicated/Private form fields, Mike provide benchmark 2-liner. Review next week and iterate.

Diego: on it :white_check_mark:

Lily: :thumbsup:

Ava: Thanks team  aiming to ship first pass early next week.
